hero.title: Tibet in Sichuan
hero.subtitle: Explore the place closest to heaven

routes.title: Featured Routes
routes.subtitle: Three carefully designed routes to immerse yourself in Tibetan culture

route1.name: Tibetan Area Walk Tour in Chengdu
route1.tagline: Experience Tibetan culture in the heart of the city
route1.description: Dive into Chengdu's Tibetan quarter, visit Tibetan shops along Wuhouci Hengjie, savor authentic Tibetan cuisine, and explore Tibetan Buddhist temples. This route lets you experience rich Tibetan culture right in the city center without traveling far.

route2.name: Go West Go Tibet
route2.tagline: An epic journey from Sichuan to Tibet
route2.description: Follow the Sichuan-Tibet Highway westward through the magnificent Hengduan Mountains, visiting Kangding, Litang, Batang and other Tibetan strongholds, before reaching the holy city of Lhasa. A life-changing pilgrimage.

route3.name: Tibetan Nomad
route3.tagline: Live like a Tibetan on the high plateau
route3.description: Venture deep into the pastoral areas of western Sichuan, live with a Tibetan nomadic family, learn to milk yaks, make butter tea, and pitch a black yak-hair tent. Experience the most authentic nomadic life on grasslands at 4,000 meters above sea level.
